decisions.reason: This low-pile carpet keeps its own product page and fits the core collection; a sibling carpet has already been cut, so it carries some risk, but it costs little to keep and sits alongside the firm's other carpets.
Hand-knotted wool silk is a high-investment craftsmanship piece that embodies the firm's stated values, so dropping it would mean writing off a visible commitment.
The firm publicly framed it as a new interpretation of the classic corner bench, which raises the cost of reversing course, although losing its own page to a mere mention suggests weaker prominence.
It is still presented on its own page and adds little marginal cost within the carpet line, so there is no pressing reason to drop it despite the cull of product C.
